DRUNKENMASTER-INGREDIENT.title: Ingredient
DRUNKENMASTER-INGREDIENT.description: A 0-cost token that [gold]Exhausts[/gold] when played. Playing it adds its effect to your [gold]Brew[/gold] instead of resolving immediately. Unplayed Ingredients vanish at end of turn.
DRUNKENMASTER-BREW.title: Brew
DRUNKENMASTER-BREW.description: A 3-slot pot. When 3 [gold]Ingredients[/gold] are in it, it seals into a [gold]Concoction[/gold] potion in a free potion slot. If no slot is free it holds until one opens. The pot empties at the end of combat.
DRUNKENMASTER-INTOXICATION.title: Intoxication
DRUNKENMASTER-INTOXICATION.description:
Gained by brewing [gold]Ethanol[/gold] into a potion and drinking it, and from some cards. Decreases by [blue]1[/blue] at the start of your turn. Some cards cost Intoxication.
[b]Sober[/b] 0-3: no effect.
[b]Tipsy[/b] 4-7: your Attacks deal [blue]2[/blue] more damage and your cards give [blue]2[/blue] more [gold]Block[/gold].
[b]Drunk[/b] 8-11: also, your hand and the cards you draw get a random cost of 0-3 this turn (sobering up restores them).
[b]Blackout[/b] 12: at the end of your turn, play the top [blue]3[/blue] cards of your draw pile, [gold]Exhaust[/gold] your hand, reset to 0, and become [gold]Hungover[/gold].
